svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: One blank, about 900 x 700 mm before folding; the shop sets bend allowances.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor 460 x 260; walls 220 tall. End walls carry 15 mm tabs that fold onto

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the outside of the long walls: 3 blind rivets each, 40, 100, 160 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front wall: window 360 x 140, 55 from the left end, 48 to 188 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rivet nuts (6.0 holes): 44 and 426 from the left end, 80 and 175 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and for the lid, 80, 230 and 380 from the left end, 213 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back wall: lid rivet nuts as the front; shelf rivets 3.3 mm at 80, 180,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 280 and 380 from the fan end, 118 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fan end: a 76 mm hole centred 110 from the front edge and 150 up, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 4.5 mm holes on a 71.5 mm square round it. Door end: see its layout.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: 24 holes of 4.5 mm; see the floor layout picture.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every edge. Set the rivet nuts with a hand rivet nut tool.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: square within 1 mm over the diagonals; lid sits on all walls.
